title: Content Block (Konsta UI, iOS + Material)
notes:
Konsta UI Content Block example: mobile components made with Tailwind CSS that follow iOS and Material Design (Android) look and feel.

Use: npm i konsta (React, Vue or Svelte). Docs: https://konstaui.com
